title: Circular Gluteal Rubbing
summary: Broad controlled circles are applied over the muscular gluteal region with consent and appropriate draping.
goal: Gradually warm the large gluteal muscles.
startingPosition: The person lies face down; only the necessary area is exposed.
instructions: Place the heel of the hand on muscle.
Avoid the sacrum and pelvic bones.
direction: Circular movements over the muscular region.
warning: Do not massage with acute pain, recent injury, marked swelling, or inflammation. One-sided swelling, redness, warmth, or calf pain should be medically assessed before massage.
